content.name: Aisha Patel
content.title: Senior Account Executive
content.summary: Account executive with nearly ten years in B2B software, from payroll to data platforms to cyber security. Sells to mid-market finance, legal and healthcare firms across the South West and Wales, and closed £1.9m in new business last year at 124% of target.

experience.title: Senior Account Executive
bullets: Closed £1.9m in new annual contract value in FY2025 (124% of target) selling managed detection and response to firms with 200 to 2,000 staff.
Won the company's largest deal to date, a three-year £680,000 contract with a regional law firm, after a seven-month evaluation with their IT and risk teams.
Built a partner channel with four local IT support providers that now sources 30% of my pipeline.
Lead Cyber Essentials-led prospecting campaigns with marketing, using the scheme as an entry point for small professional services firms.
Mentor two newer AEs on forecasting discipline and multi-threading into finance and compliance stakeholders.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold a reporting and data warehouse platform to UK accountancy practices, exceeding target in nine of 13 quarters.
Grew average contract value from £18,000 to £27,500 by packaging onboarding and training as a fixed-fee add-on.
Ran remote evaluations in 2020 with a two-week pilot template that kept win rates at 31% despite no site visits.
Presented at three ICAEW regional events, generating 70 new leads.

experience.title: Business Development Representative
bullets: Booked 25 to 30 meetings a month for field sales by calling HR and finance managers in companies with 50 to 500 employees.
Built territory lists from Companies House data, keeping the CRM free of duplicates for a team of seven.
Promoted to account executive track after finishing as top BDR for 2018.
